reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues block the actor-classification and malware-relationship changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Updates Recorded Future malware-link imports to distinguish people from groups, addressing the cross-type alias collision behind the name changes reported in #8257. **Changes:** - Maps linked threat-actor Persons to Threat Actor Individuals while keeping Organizations as Intrusion Sets. - Creates actor-to-malware `uses` relationships for both types. - Adds regression tests and documents the classification change. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `external-import/​recorded-future/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_rf_to_stix2.py` | Tests actor classification, individual IDs, and relationship direction. | | `external-import/​recorded-future/​src/​rflib/​rf_to_stix2.py` | Selects actor types by RF entity type and supports Threat Actor relationships. | | `external-import/​recorded-future/​README.md` | Documents how linked threat-actor Persons are imported. |
Review effort: Balanced
